name: Amphenol
outlook:
What Amphenol says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: sales and adjusted diluted EPSAssuming the continuation of current market conditions as well as constant exchange rates, for the fourth quarter of 2026, Amphenol expects sales to be in the range of $10.3 to $10.5 billion, representing an approximately 60% increase over the prior year quarter. Adjusted Diluted EPS is expected to be in the range of $0.81 to $0.83, representing a 65% to 69% increase from the fourth quarter of 2025.
  • Full year 2026: sales and adjusted diluted EPSFor the full year 2026, Amphenol expects sales to be in the range of $36.9 billion to $37.1 billion, representing an approximately 60% increase over prior year, while Adjusted Diluted EPS is expected to be in the range of $2.82 to $2.84, representing an approximately 70% increase over prior year.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 28, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
